info.name: Optibus Operations Driver Absences Tasks API

params.name: depotId
params.description: - The depot to get the tasks from

params.name: from
params.description: - The start of the date range to return the tasks from

params.name: to
params.description: - The end of the date range to return the tasks from

params.name: plan
params.description: -  Returns tasks from the given plans

params.name: group
params.description: - Returns tasks from deployed plans for the given groups

params.name: type
params.description: - Returns tasks from the given types

params.name: assignedOnly
params.description: -  Returns tasks that are either assigned or unassigned (depending on the input)

params.name: includeStops
params.description: -  Returns the stops of tasks (false by default)

params.name: driversIds
params.description: -  Returns the assignments of filtered driver

items.docs:
Returns the Daily and Weekly tasks for a specified date range, with filters.
Responds with 302 redirect when payload is too big.
OriginalDriverId refers to the driver that was assigned to the task in the plan page

**Spare Types Support**: When the spare types feature flag is enabled, spare tasks will include additional properties:
- `spareType`: The spare type code (e.g., "SPARE1", "SPARE2")
- `displayId`: Will show the configured spare type name instead of the original display ID
- `dutyType`:
